name: Corridor A — Upper Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Upper deck corridor. Emergency lights pulse. Hatches lead in several directions — some sealed.

hotspots.label: Engineering Hatch
hotspots.lockedMessage: The engineering hatch needs the emergency seal cleared first.

hotspots.label: Command Deck
hotspots.lockedMessage: Command deck blast doors are sealed — requires main power restored.

action.text:
LIFE SUPPORT STATUS — MERIDIAN ALPHA

Primary scrubbers: OFFLINE (no power)
CO2 filters: OFFLINE
O2 generation: OFFLINE
Backup tanks: 22% (approximately 28 minutes)

Power reroute required from Engineering Deck.
Standard reroute sequence is in the Engineering manual.
Blast door override will engage once power is restored.

MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA — DECK DIRECTORY

Upper Deck:
  → Airlock Bay (Stern)
  → Crew Quarters (Port)
  → Medical Bay (Starboard)
  → Command Deck (Bow) [BLAST DOOR SEALED]
  → Engineering Hatch [Lower Deck]

Lower Deck:
  → Engineering
  → Cargo Bay
  → Reactor Deck [RESTRICTED]
  → Comms Array
  → Escape Pod Bay (Stern)
